title: Strawberries and Wine
description: Wonderful dessert that is light and refreshing. The strawberries marinate in the wine for hours producing a strawberry flavor wine at the bottom of the bowl that everyone will be fighting for. Great way to dress up not-too-sweet strawberries!
ingredients: 3 cups fresh strawberries, hulled and quartered lengthwise
0.75 cup white sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Place strawberries into a medium bowl. Dust with sugar, then pour the wine over them. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
Let the strawberries stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes before serving. Spoon berries into 6 dessert cups, and distribute the remaining wine over the berries.
